scenario: 显存省下来，不等于推理就变快。GAAC 要把解压放进注意力读取，FlashOffloading 要让搬运跟计算交叠；FastAFD 则提醒我们，把专家卡也算进去，拆分后的吞吐优势可能很小。这期看优化，先问省下的容量怎样变成整步收益，再看对照是否把额外资源算全。

papers.title: GAAC: Lossless KV Compression for Bandwidth-Efficient LLM Inference on Personal Devices
papers.authors: Yipin Guo, Arun M George, Siddharth Joshi
papers.abstract: Weight-only, lossy quantization substantially reduces the storage and memory requirements for serving large language models (LLMs), but the growing key-value (KV) cache remains a bottleneck for long-context inference on personal devices. We present Group-Adaptive Additive Codec (GAAC), a lossless KV compression and serving system that exploits exponent redundancy to reduce storage and accelerate attention without introducing KV approximation. GAAC encodes BF16 exponents using calibrated per-channel base-plus-offset codes over contiguous ranges. GAAC adapts code widths across small groups while preserving KV values bit-for-bit. A fused attention kernel reconstructs KV tiles on the fly, avoiding full-cache decompression. Block-wise compression and fixed-capacity slots support incremental cache updates and paged serving. Across five tested models, GAAC achieves 1.405-1.407$\times$ lossless BF16 KV compression. We also study compression performance on low-precision tensors FP8 E4M3 caches
papers.summary: KV 压缩省下内存，却未必加速解码：先整份解压，仍要搬运原来那么多数据。GAAC 保留 BF16 的符号和尾数，把指数减去预先选好的基准，只存差值；按注意力读取顺序，每八个 KV 元素成组；差值装不下，就让整组用更宽的差值编码，必要时存原始指数。用时加回基准，KV 逐位还原。注意力计算读一小块就解一小块，不先展开完整缓存。DGX Spark 实验中，KV 常驻内存减少约26%，同批量整步解码速度达到基线的1.04–1.15倍。收益取决于 KV 读取是否已成为瓶颈。

papers.title: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
papers.authors: Teresa Delgado, Hugo Hazard, Martin Benfeghoul, Jun Wang, Zafeirios Fountas
papers.abstract: Autoregressive decoding relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length and caps batch size and throughput. Existing post-training methods exploit redundancy across tokens, layers, and feature dimensions, or lower numerical precision. We identify a complementary axis: within each attention head, values are largely predictable from their corresponding keys. We exploit this with value cache amortisation, which fits a lightweight per-head predictor at test time and stores residuals only for the tokens it reconstructs worst, giving $4\times$ near-lossless value compression. The predictor can be initialised by meta-learning for substantially reduced prefill overhead, or fitted from scratch in settings that allow a one-off cost, such as multi-query inference. We pair value amortisation with cross-layer low-rank key compression to produce LowRAM, an asymmetric compression pipeline that stays close to lossless across three model families. By reconstructing onl
papers.summary: KV 不必两份都完整存：同一注意力头里，V 的不少信息可从 K 预测。LowRAM 为当前上下文的每个头训练小网络，用 K 重建 V，只给误差最大的 token 另存修正量；K 则用跨层低秩分解压缩。Mistral 的 LongBench 测试中，KV 存储压到原来的四分之一，保留97.9%的基线分数。这是以拟合开销换存储，是否划算还取决于长上下文会被复用多少次。

papers.title: StrataFlux: Memory-Hierarchy-Native Low-Bit LLM Inference
papers.authors: Jake Hyun, Ziyu Zhao, Jae-sun Seo, Mohamed S. Abdelfattah
papers.abstract: Quantization reduces the memory and bandwidth demands of large language model (LLM) inference but can degrade accuracy; offloading higher-precision data can instead stall generation. We introduce StrataFlux, a framework that challenges this tradeoff by recovering accuracy lost to low-bit weight and key-value (KV) cache quantization while retaining quantization's memory and speed advantages. StrataFlux co-designs refinement representation, selection, and delivery to make host RAM and solid-state drives useful sources of additional precision. Its selective precision streaming reduces transfer volume, overlaps delivery with computation, and reuses fetched precision across decoding steps so generation need not wait for every transfer. We evaluate 2-4-bit weights and 2-3-bit KV-cache on dedicated GPUs and unified-memory platforms. For 2-bit Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct weights, StrataFlux reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 9.46 to 8.40 while maintaining 95.4% of the quantized base's throughput on
papers.summary: 低比特量化省显存，却会损失精度。StrataFlux 用校准数据拟合补偿矩阵，目标是补回投影的量化误差。先把较早层的状态向量归一化，按分量绝对值从大到小挑编号，预取补偿矩阵同编号的列。每列乘当前输入同编号的分量，乘积相加后补到低比特投影。RTX 5090 的 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 在 YAQA 两比特量化实验中，WikiText-2 困惑度从9.46降至8.40，空上下文解码保留95.4%的原量化吞吐。这是小幅牺牲速度换回部分精度，不是无损恢复。

papers.title: BlockLock: Reproducible LLM Inference with Fixed Batch Geometry
papers.authors: Xiuyuan Qi, Pedro Reviriego, Javier Conde, Shanshan Liu
papers.abstract: Reproducible LLM inference requires that a request produces the same output regardless of the other requests in the batch. Existing solutions pay for this in different ways: batch-invariant kernels constrain every operator, and isolating prefill with fixed-shape decode ({our CoRun-style baseline}) gives up shared prefill compute and pads decode. We present BlockLock, which keeps shared batched prefill and pins only the numerical path of the protected request: it fixes the geometry that the request sees, with {two modes: BlockLock-Rows uses fixed-width rows and retains batched decode of all requests; BlockLock-Pack uses terminal-anchored packing with an isolated dummy segment, then extracts the protected request's KV state for target-only decode. Under a stated per-deployment contract, both modes preserve the target's output bitwise when its companions change.} Across five {dense} models (Qwen3-8B/14B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Gemma-3-4B/12B-IT) and three single-GPU deployments (NVIDI
papers.summary: 同一条提示，换掉同批其他请求，也可能改变贪心解码的答案。BlockLock-Rows 固定批量大小和行宽，让目标请求保持同一行与位置，其他请求仍一起 prefill 和解码。单卡实验比较同一提示搭配不同请求的两次输出，普通填充批处理的完全一致率为52.59%，该方案为100%。前提是底层算子在固定形状下本身能重复得到相同结果。它用调度和填充换复现性，不保证换批量大小或换 GPU 后仍相同；提示长度差太多时，填充也会变贵。

papers.title: FastAFD: When Does Attention-FFN Disaggregation Pay on Rack-Scale NVLink?
papers.authors: Yichao Fu, Yuxuan Zhang, Minshen Zhang, Ruitian Wang, Junda Chen, Hao Zhang
papers.abstract: Attention-FFN disaggregation (AFD) separates attention from the experts of a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model and has been reported to raise decode throughput over colocated serving. Whether this advantage holds on rack-scale NVLink systems such as GB200 NVL72 remains unclear: prior results were obtained on other hardware, against narrower colocated baselines, or with analytical models, whereas production engines serve large MoE models on these systems with wide expert parallelism (wide EP). We build and tune FastAFD, an AFD engine for GB200 NVL72 that overlaps the MoE of one microbatch with the attention of the other, and compare it against the best vLLM wide EP setting. Experiments show that AFD has a throughput advantage of up to 1.17x over wide EP on Qwen3 and 1.16x on Qwen3.5, and matches it on MiniMax-M2.5. We derive an analytical model that predicts AFD throughput within 3% using only profiles of colocated vLLM, telling whether switching to AFD would pay off before deploying it. T
papers.summary: 把专家拆到另一组 GPU，注意力卡能装更多 KV，也能让一批的专家计算与另一批的注意力交叠。但专家卡同样要算成本。FastAFD 在 GB200 NVL72 上重算这笔账：对照是按负载调优专家并行宽度的 vLLM，将专家卡也计入每卡吞吐后，普通解码仅达到对照的0.99–1.17倍。拆分是否划算，要看多装请求与交叠计算的收益，能否抵掉专家池占用的 GPU；不能拿没调好的小规模并行作对照，就宣布拆分普遍更快。

papers.title: KOSMOS: Self-scheduling Persistent Kernels for Communication-Compute Overlap
papers.authors: Alexander Magro, Aristotle Martin, Ye Wang, Wen Chen
papers.abstract: Tensor and sequence parallelism (TP+SP) and expert parallelism (EP) put collectives on the critical path of transformer layers. State-of-the-art fused kernels mitigate this with fixed roles or schedules, but this rigidity leaves large idle windows. Predicting a communication-computation split does not remove them either; a predetermined split cannot follow data readiness. We present KOSMOS, a library for self-scheduling persistent kernels whose workgroups use queues ordered by consumer demand to switch between communication and computation roles as data become ready, with no scheduler, per-call cost model, or tuned split. KOSMOS fuses every TP+SP collective of a transformer layer with its GEMM, and runs an entire expert layer, from router to fold, in one launch per direction. Evaluated on AMD Instinct MI350X and AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, KOSMOS speeds up TP+SP end-to-end training in Megatron-LM by 1.10-1.28x in BF16 and 1.10-1.25x in MXFP8. KOSMOS accelerates end-to-end training of Dee
papers.summary: 多卡训练里，预先分好哪些计算单元搬数据、哪些做矩阵乘，容易让一边忙、一边等。KOSMOS 把两类工作放进同一常驻核函数，工作组依队列和数据就绪标记协作；搬完数据的组可转去计算，专家输出回传时还能来回换工。AMD 单机实验的 MoE 代理训练吞吐达到 DeepEP 对照的1.29–1.83倍。它改变的是通信与计算在执行中如何分工，目前依赖机内互连，不能直接外推多机收益。

papers.title: flash-comm: Self-Synchronizing Collective Communication for LLM Decoding
papers.authors: Carrie Wang, Jack Li, Jason Zhao
papers.abstract: We present flash-comm, a communication library that achieves efficient transport for LLM decoding by fusing readiness synchronization with data movement. flash-comm introduces self-synchronizing transfers in which each data block carries evidence of its readiness, allowing receivers to directly validate the blocks they need without separate inter-GPU barriers. Based on this principle, a cost-guided protocol selector adapts the readiness encoding to message size and the number of participating GPUs, balancing synchronization overhead against additional data-transfer cost. flash-comm further decouples transport order from reduction order to preserve result consistency across GPUs under asynchronous data arrivals. On a server with eight NVIDIA B300 GPUs, flash-comm reduces all-reduce latency by a median of 28.8% and up to 43.7% compared with custom AR v2 (the state-of-the-art all-reduce implementation). In end-to-end decoding, flash-comm reduces time per output token (TPOT) by 1.7-6.8%. N
papers.summary: 多卡解码中，等待所有 GPU 确认就绪的同步，可能比小包传输本身还贵。Flash-Comm 主要路径先在接收区放标记值，数据写入后覆盖标记；接收方看到所需块已写好，就继续处理，不先等全组同步。各卡独立求和时仍按固定 GPU 顺序累加，避免算出不同结果。八卡 B300 的 DeepSeek 解码测试中，TPOT 下降1.7–6.8%。它优化通信，不改其余模型计算；微基准里的降幅不能等比例当成整步加速。

papers.title: FlashOffloading: Low-Latency KV Cache Offloading for Long-Context LLM Serving
papers.authors: Xuan Wang, Zhuanhao Wu, Tingzhu Fang, Xushi Li, Sicheng Zhang, Zhenyu Yang, Feng Liu, Zhaohui Fan, Qiang Xie, Huayi Zou, Yuncong Liu, Zeyu Song, Ke Zhu, Yanjia Zeng, Jingchun Gao, Yan Shi, Kui Luo, Gezi Li, Liangjun Feng, Cheng Li
papers.abstract: In large language model (LLM) serving systems, the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length and concurrency, so long-context inference easily hits the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity wall and results in low concurrency. Offloading the KV cache to host dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) frees HBM space and raises concurrency, but the additional cache management and host-to-device (H2D) load overhead inflates inference latency, higher concurrency fails to translate into effective throughput. We present FlashOffloading, a host-DRAM-centric inference architecture that fully offloads the KV cache in both the prefill and decode phases. FlashOffloading builds rolling HBM cache for prefill, a hot cache for decode, a reverse sparse index with zero extra miss-lookup overhead, and a compute--load overlapped kernel, optimizing KV offloading latency across the entire pipeline and delivering throughput gains under a time-per-output-token (TPOT) service-level objective (SLO). In experiments deploying GLM-5.2 with multi-token prediction (MTP3) speculative decoding on an Ascend910C prefill--decode (PD)-disaggregated platform, FlashOffloading improves prefill throughput by up to 1.38× and decode throughput by up to 1.91× under a 30 ms TPOT constraint. FlashOffloading is integrated into an open-source serving framework: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/tree/releases/v0.30.0.
papers.summary: 把 KV 放进主机内存，能多装请求，却可能被来回搬运拖慢。FlashOffloading 在 prefill 把历史 KV 从主机内存按层搬回设备，在解码时只取模型稀疏索引选中的 KV；选 token 时同时拿到缓存位置，再让搬运与计算交叠。昇腾平台的 GLM 测试中，128K 输入下放大运行批量，输出吞吐达到对照的1.91倍，平均 TPOT 为26毫秒。收益来自容量换并发和压低搬运开销，不代表单请求更快；解码路径也依赖模型原生稀疏选择。

papers.title: Recast: Refinement-Centered Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search Optimized for Storage
papers.authors: Zehai Yang, Fengyi Tao, Wenzhuo Dong, Shimin Chen
papers.abstract:
Large-scale ANNS systems often exploit storage in addition to DRAM for supporting vector search. The central question is how to divide the work between memory and storage for achieving both high query throughput-recall and good index maintenance performance. Existing storage-optimized ANNS paradigms fall short of providing a complete answer: disk-resident graph indexes have difficulty in supporting efficient vector deletions, while posting-list systems often incur more disk I/Os for queries.
In this paper, we introduce a refinement-centered paradigm for storage-optimized ANNS systems. We propose Recast as a concrete design of this paradigm. Recast stores raw vectors on disk and keeps an IVF index with our RecastQ quantization encoding in memory. For an ANNS query, Recast selects nprobe inverted lists and performs SIMD-based FastScan on their RecastQ codes to identify refinement candidates in memory.
It then retrieves candidate vectors from disk, computes exact distances, and refines the top-K result. To reduce disk I/Os, RecastQ computes uncertainty intervals containing true distances with high probability. Our QUIC policy selects a minimal refinement set based on these intervals, minimizing candidate-retrieval I/Os. Both the on-disk raw vectors and the in-memory IVF structure support insertions and deletions.
Experiments on real-world data sets show that Recast processes batched insertions and deletions 3.10-37.27x faster than SPFresh and OdinANN, while its QPS at 0.99 recall changes by at most 6.9% after updating 50% of the corpus. For static queries at 0.99 recall, Recast achieves 1.56-2.01x the QPS of the strongest baseline with the matched memory budget on each data set, while requiring 1.22-6.75x less external storage than the evaluated systems.
At matched in-memory space, RecastQ also provides a better Recall-refinement frontier than RaBitQ.
papers.summary: 向量放到 SSD 后，精排读回多少原始向量，会直接影响检索吞吐。Recast 把倒排索引和量化码留在内存，先估距离及误差范围，只把仍可能进入前列的候选读回精算，而不是每个查询固定读同样多候选。静态实验在给定内存预算、召回率0.99时，查询吞吐达到最强对照的1.56–2.01倍。它把读盘预算随查询难度调整，但区间筛选补不回倒排列表阶段漏掉的近邻。

papers.title: Configure, Certify, and Operate Kubernetes GPU Clusters with NVIDIA DSX OS
papers.abstract: One underperforming GPU can slow an entire distributed training job. The node may pass basic health checks and show normal utilization, leaving operators to...
papers.summary: 节点健康检查全绿，分布式训练仍可能被一张慢卡拖住。NVIDIA DSX OS 把版本配置、负载认证和修复后的再验证接起来。NVCRE 跑训练和 NCCL 测试，但默认不设性能阈值，测试能启动不代表带宽达标；示例的300 GB/s 是配置门槛，不是实测提速。启用生命周期管理后，NVSentinel 协调验证，修复节点通过测试才解除调度隔离。重点是先定验收标准，再把修复后重验接进恢复流程。
